chunks: And from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah (Glorious is His Majesty) gives the world to the one He loves and the one He despises, but He gives the Hereafter only to the one He loves. And if a believer were to ask the Lord for a foot of land in this world, He might deny him; but if he were to ask for the Hereafter, He would give him whatever he wished. He gives the disbeliever whatever he wishes in this world, but if he were to ask for a foot of land in the Hereafter, He would not give that to him.

key_terms.مَوْضِعَ سَوْطٍ: A foot of land (literally: the space of a whip)

ai.seo_question: Why does Allah give the world to both believers and disbelievers?
ai.summary: Abu Ja'far (a.s.) explains that Allah grants the worldly life to both those He loves and those He despises, but the Hereafter is exclusive to those He loves. A believer may be denied even a small portion of the world but is guaranteed whatever he asks for in the Hereafter, whereas a disbeliever may receive whatever he desires in this world but will be denied even a small portion of it in the Hereafter.
